scope.visualMethod: Viewed each shipped WebP individually at readable resolution; compared visible humans with canonical portrait references. Read each complete MDX, including code, choices, exercises as embedded, recaps and epilogues. Rechecked three high-impact images individually while writing findings.
scope.limits: This is a visual and source audit. No artwork was regenerated, no product code changed, and no in-browser responsive render or exercise runtime was tested. Mobile readability observations are composition and scale judgments, not measured viewport screenshots. Conceptual fictional graphics are not required to reproduce numerical exercise outputs.

verdict: The face-first art direction is working. These four modules are not uniformly grim: temporal attention, ensemble work, caching and documentation already have warmth, curiosity and recognizable people. The main creative weakness is repetitive seated-listener and standing-explainer staging, followed by overreliance on green screens to carry scene-specific meaning. Most fixes should preserve the cast and room rather than restart them.
